name: Campingplatz Waldesruh
beschreibung: The Waldesruh campsite is located in Wertach in the Tiroler Außerfern. It is situated in a quiet forest-edge location. The surroundings are characterized by alpine meadows, forests and the mountain panorama of the Allgäuer und Lechtaler Alpen. In summer, the hiking trails and cycling routes are used for leisure activities. In winter, the ski area Wertach and cross-country ski trails are reachable. The facilities include pitches with electricity, a sanitary building and a bread roll service. A common room and a playground complete the offering. The campsite is suitable for motorhomes, caravans and tents.
